### Validation and limitations

No relevant articles were supplied. The build screened three eligible records into a **development** set; the final strategy retrieved all three (100% relative recall against that set). This is not an estimate of sensitivity. There is no independent validation set or prior-review benchmark. A candidate systematic review was found, but its included studies could not be retrieved through PubMed links.

The result set is large, and screening noise is expected because school delivery and consumption outcomes remain screening criteria. The internal PRESS-structured critique closed with no open must-fix findings; human PRESS peer review is still pending. A suggested “Nutrition Education” MeSH heading was not added because lookup found no such heading and the direct tagged check fell back to All Fields.
